name: BTC volatility index, realized line
status: in force once the inception decision 2026-11-05-qvol-inception is anchored (see decisions.jsonl); the first line is dated 2026-11-06 — a measurement: the realized volatility of bitcoin over the 30 UTC days before 00:00 UTC of each line's date, from closed Binance spot bars, one line per UTC day; nothing is held, nothing can be bought, there is no fee; a testnet display vault with no deposits shows the value as its share price.
_doc: Rules of the qVOL realized line (keeper/vol-index.mjs --line realized). The rulebook is rulebooks/qvol.md in this repository; the inception decision pins this file's sha256, and every line carries it as rule.rulebookSha256. Every value below except display is a definition: the price source (owner 2026-11-02) or a measurement convention fixed by a published methodology document (rulebook appendix P). None is a tested value and none was chosen by a test: the one pre-registered test of this line is of reproducibility, which chooses no value. The line dated D uses the closes of UTC days D-31 ... D-1 and their 30 log returns; variance = (yearDays / windowDays) x the sum of squared returns, no mean subtracted; value = 100 x sqrt(variance), recorded as computed (binary64, no decimal rounding). display is an operating value of the page (rulebook appendix O), not part of the definition: the page shows the record value to two decimals as a presentation only; it never feeds the record or the vault mark. The vault mark is floor(value x 1,000,000) in the contract's 1e-6 unit, a truncation that rounds down; the keeper has no two-decimal rounding and no half-way rule. sampling: one return per UTC day, close to close, the day boundary at 00:00 UTC. close: the close of a UTC day is the close of the latest 1-minute bar that opened on that day. A day with other than 1,440 bars halts the series until a person accepts that exact set of bars in keeper/vol-index-gaps.json; bars are never filled; a day with no bar at all (only after an accepted gap) takes the previous close. There is no genesis level: a line's value is the measured volatility itself. There is no fee: nothing is held. Changing any value after a decision pinned this file is a rule change: a new decision, never an edit.
